facts.fact: The Minister of Digital Transformation says the Ain app, launched in October 2024, had recorded about 9,000 requests and complaints on access to basic services by May 2025.
The minister states 96% of requests and complaints on Ain have been processed, the other 4% being in progress, and that 52% of citizens rating the service call it good quality.
